headline: Australian Retailer David Jones Cuts 1,500 Jobs Following Administration
summary: Troubled Australian retailer David Jones is cutting 1,500 jobs after entering administration on November 5.
why: Retail insolvencies and large-scale redundancies reflect broader pressures on consumer spending, retail margins, and domestic employment markets.

impacts.name: David Jones
impacts.why: Entering administration and massive job cuts severely impair the company's financial viability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
